title: Finding the right career
competency: Follow seven steps to find the right career and make a career action plan.

keywords.def: A short list of the two to five careers left after removing the ones you do not want.
A goal you can usually reach in six months to three years.
A goal that typically takes about three to five years to reach.
A written document listing all the steps to reach your career goals: a roadmap from A to B to C to D.

ideas.name: From a long list to a choice

en.text: To find the right career, follow seven steps. 1: make one master list of occupations. 2: explore it and reduce it to five to ten options. 3: narrow it to a shortlist of two to five. 4: get in-depth information, especially from people working in those careers. 5: make your choice, the career that will bring you most satisfaction. You can change your mind later in life.

am.text: ትክክለኛ ሙያ ለማግኘት ሰባት ደረጃዎች አሉ፤ ዝርዝር ማውጣት፣ ማሳጠር፣ መረጃ መሰብሰብ፣ መምረጥ።

screens.title: Too many choices
screens.ask: You have 30 possible careers on your list. What is the next sensible step?
opts: Explore them and reduce the list to 5–10
screens.after: Step 2: explore the list and reduce it to five to ten options.

screens.title: Steps 1–5
paras: Step 1: make a list of occupations to explore; combine your lists into one master list.
Step 2: explore the list and reduce it to five to ten options.
Step 3: narrow down the list; keep two to five on your shortlist.
Step 4: get more information; ask people who work in those careers for firsthand knowledge.
Step 5: make your career choice: the one that will bring the most satisfaction. You may change your mind later.

screens.title: Key words
defs: A short list of the two to five careers left after removing the ones you do not want.

screens.clue: The list gets shorter each time.

screens.text: At step 4, the best source of firsthand knowledge is
Once you choose a career, you can never change your mind.
screens.why: p.8: "you are allowed to change your mind about your choice at any point in your life."

screens.text: Meron's shortlist is nurse, tailor and electrician. What should she do before choosing?
opts: Talk to a nurse, a tailor and an electrician about their work
Choose the one her friend chose
screens.ans: Talk to a nurse, a tailor and an electrician about their work
screens.why: Step 4: seek advice from people engaged in the careers on your shortlist to get firsthand knowledge.
screens.clue: Which step comes after the shortlist?

ideas.name: Goals and a career action plan

en.text: Step 6: identify your goals. Short-term goals take six months to three years; long-term goals take about three to five years. Step 7: write a career action plan, a document that lists every step to reach your goals, like a roadmap from A to B to C to D.

am.text: 6ኛ ደረጃ፡ ግቦችን መለየት (አጭርና ረጅም ጊዜ)። 7ኛ ደረጃ፡ ወደ ግቡ የሚያደርሱ ደረጃዎችን የያዘ የሙያ የድርጊት ዕቅድ መጻፍ።

screens.title: Near and far goals
screens.ask: "Finish Grade 10 next year" and "own an electrical shop in five years". Which is long-term?
opts: Own an electrical shop in five years
screens.after: Long-term goals take about three to five years.

screens.title: Steps 6 and 7
paras: Step 6: identify your goals. Short-term: six months to three years. Long-term: about three to five years.
Step 7: make a career action plan, a written document with all the steps to reach your goals: a roadmap from A to B to C to D.

screens.title: Key words
defs: A goal you can usually reach in six months to three years.
A goal that typically takes about three to five years to reach.
A written document listing all the steps to reach your career goals: a roadmap from A to B to C to D.

items: Earn a TVET diploma in 4 years
Help a carpenter on weekends this term
Open my own bakery in 5 years

screens.text: In the process of finding the right career, what is the importance of identifying your goals?
opts: It helps you implement your career choice
It reduces the number of careers listed
screens.ans: It helps you implement your career choice
screens.why: Goals come after the choice and turn it into action.

screens.text: Which one is a correct statement about finding the right career?
opts: Narrowing the list helps focus on some careers
Getting more information gives in-depth knowledge
Identifying goals helps put the choice into action

screens.text: A career action plan is described as a roadmap. Why?
opts: It shows the steps from where you are now (A) to your goal (D)
It shows the roads in your town
It lists all careers in the world
screens.ans: It shows the steps from where you are now (A) to your goal (D)
screens.why: p.9: it "lays out all the steps you will have to take to reach your goals… from point A to B, then to C and D".

notes.text: Step 3 keeps "two to five" careers but Step 4 says "three to five"; the lesson uses the Step 3 wording. Review III Q3 has no answer key; b is used, but c ("helps develop a career action plan") is also defensible.
